doc.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Jobs at the Jazz Gallery and other clubs
summary: She clarifies she worked Birdland and Basin Street before Los Angeles and the Jazz Gallery after, never the Half Note or Five Spot.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well the jump. I mean we can... it doesn’t matter if we go back and forth there.
So I do have here in my notes, that once you’re back in New York once again you’re working in Basin Street and the Jazz Gallery, was that true?
No, I worked there at those clubs before I went to Los Angeles. When I came back from Los Angeles I worked at the Jazz Gallery.

And I think maybe, yeah I think that that’s... I never worked at the Half Note or the Five Spot. I think I subbed at the Five Spot once in the cloak room, but it was such a small cloak room. I didn’t like it.
At Basin Street when you were there did you ever meet Phoebe Jacobs? Was she, no?
What, did she work in the cloak room?
Well you know my memory might be a little wrong there but I remember Phoebe talking about Basin Street
Wow, maybe I did. I wouldn’t have known her last name.
